title:
Your car loan just cost you
*$250,000*

lines.say: You earn 10,000 dollars a month and pay 1,200 for your car. That could cut 250,000 off your condo budget.
Banks cap all your debts at 55% of income: 5,500 dollars a month.
Your car loan takes 1,200 of that, leaving 4,300 for the home loan.
Tested at 4% over 30 years, that's about 900,000 instead of 1.15 million.
Clearing a car loan before you buy can change the whole plan.
Check your numbers before you view, not after.
Comment PLAN and we'll send you the calculator used in this video.

caption:
Earn $10,000 a month and pay $1,200 for your car? That could cut $250,000 off your condo budget. 🚗

Banks cap all your debts at 55% of income: $5,500 a month. Your car loan takes $1,200, leaving $4,300 for the home loan. Tested at 4% over 30 years, that's about $900,000 instead of $1.15 million.

Clearing a car loan before you buy can change the whole plan. Check your numbers before you view, not after.

Comment PLAN and we'll send you the calculator used in this video 👇

MAS TDSR, 4% medium term rate floor. Illustration.
